summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed a Form 6-K announcing a board resolution to issue KRW 270 billion of write-down contingent capital securities (Additional Tier 1) under Basel III. The perpetual securities include a call option redeemable every interest payment date after 5 years up to 10 years. A point of non-viability trigger would write off principal and interest if the company is deemed insolvent. The issuance is a routine capital management move, not a special situation.
